[[File:Anzat_feed.jpg|thumb|250px|An Anzat uses his proboscises on Quinlan Vos.]]
A '''proboscis''' (plural '''proboscises''') was an extensible tubular sucking organ. The [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] possessed two prehensile proboscises that they kept coiled in their cheek pockets. They used those appendages to consume the [[Brain/Legends|brain]] matter of their victims, which they referred to as "the [[Soup (Anzati)|soup]]."<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
